name: Multimodal Document Retrieval Baseline
problem: Business documents contain meaning in text, tables, layout, and imagery that text-only retrieval can miss.
recommended_stack: FastAPI for ingestion and multimodal search
Transformers with LayoutLMv3 or ColPali-style encoders
PostgreSQL plus pgvector for fused embeddings

real_world_data_sources.name: SEC EDGAR company facts API
real_world_data_sources.purpose: Real tabular filing facts and document metadata

real_world_data_sources.name: arXiv API
real_world_data_sources.purpose: Public papers and document-layout retrieval scenarios

job_description_skills: OCR, layout, image, and text feature fusion
Scalable document ingestion and object storage
impact_targets: Improve Recall@5 by >= 20% over text-only retrieval
Report modality ablations for OCR, layout, and image signals
Keep p95 retrieval latency below 500 ms
